meta.title: Redaura — infraestructura di alerta pa reduccion di daño
hero.sub: Redaura ta permiti organizacionnan di test di droga y reduccion di daño manda un aviso pa tur telefon den un area defini, den segundo, den e idioma di e lector, na nomber di e organizacion.
hero.pushBody: Cerca di bo: pildornan bendi como MDMA ta contene PMMA. Alerta pa Unity · Jellinek.
stats.l1: For di aprobacion te na telefon den e area
stats.l3: Costo pa organizacionnan di reduccion di daño
stats.l4: Dato di localisacion cu ta sali for di aparato
gap.p1: Pa 1'or di marduga na un festival, un equipo di test ta descubri un muestra mal etiqueta. Nan tin e resultado, e equipo y binti aña di confiansa cu e bishitantenan. Nan unico manera pa spardie e aviso ta un borchi dilanti di e tent y un publicacion cu ta yega na esnan cu ta sigui nan caba.
gap.p2: Sistemanan di monitoreo nacional tin e alcance, pero no e mandato aki. Nan ta acumula dato, analisa tendencia y saca guia despues di simannan. Nan no a wordo traha pa pone un alerta riba trinta mil telefon awe nochi.
gap.heading: Redaura ta conecta tur hende.
feat1.title: Solamente organizacion di confiansa ta publica
feat1.copy: Acreditacion ta sosode prome cu un cuenta ta existi. Un voluntario na e punto di test ta traha e alerta; un lider designa ta laga esaki sali. Dos persona, tur biaha.
feat2.title: Alertanan structura, no texto liber
feat2.copy: Alertanan ta traha di camponan fiho, no como texto liber. Tur valor ta revisa pa expertonan den 20+ idioma, asina un alerta di un equipo Hulandes ta yega directamente den e idioma nativo na Polaco of Aleman sin tardanza di traduccion y sin espacio pa slang of ambiguedad.
feat3.title: Ningun hende ta wordo sigui
feat3.copy: Verificacion di localisacion ta sosode localmente riba e telefon — e telefon ta calcula si e ta den un area di alerta. Nada no ta wordo transmiti, nada no ta wordo registra, nada no por wordo demanda pa corte. Esaki ta e arquitectura, no un opcion.
feat4.title: E datonan ta bai den tur dos direccion
feat4.copy: Paso alertanan ta structura, e mesun publicacion cu ta yega na telefonnan awe nochi por yega na monitoreo nacional awe nochi, den un formato cu nan sistemanan ta lesa caba.
feat.offline.title: Traha pa zonanan sin señal.
feat.offline.body: Rednan di telefon na festivalnan ta bira yena precies ora alertanan ta mas vital. E app ta habri instantaneamente cu e ultimo alertanan conoci, ta mustra ki tempo el a sincronisa, y ta actualisa riba e minimo señal. Alertanan ta yega denter di e push mes — legibel mas cu nada otro no carga.
app.title: Un app.
app.note1: Usuarionan ta download un solo client global; e alertanan riba dje ta pertenece na e organizacionnan cu ta publica nan — nan nomber, nan logo, nan referencia di laboratorio. E confiansa traha riba tereno ta biaha cu e advertencia.
app.note2: Toca un alerta pa habri e. Un push ta yega un par di segundo despues, of ripiti e bao di e telefon.
quote.text: “Nos tin e voluntarionan, e kitnan di test, y binti aña di confiansa. Loke nos nunca tabatin tabata €50.000 pa un app.”
quote.attr: — Coordinador di testmento di droga, futuro partner di piloto
proto.lead: Alertanan ta wordo publica den un formato abri y documenta — cualkier organizacion, laboratorio, of sistema di alarma nacional por publica y consumi nan. Sin lock-in, completamente compatibel cu e standard di emergencia CAP.
proto.point1.title: Di bo pa semper
proto.point1.body: Exporta tur dato di alerta, esquema, y historia na cualkier momento. Sin formatonan propietario of base di dato sera.
proto.point2.title: Interoperabel
proto.point2.body: Ta conecta directamente cu sistemanan existente di alarma y infraestructura di seguridad publico.
proto.point3.title: Prueba di futuro
proto.point3.body: E especificacion abri ta dura mas largo cu cualkier compania of organizacion. Infraestructura di reduccion di daño ta keda publico.
proto.bridge: Sosionan fundador ta yuda forma e especificacion for di prome dia →
pilot.title: Prototipo cu ta funciona. Protocol abri.
pilot.note:
Un fundacion sin fin di lucro registra na Hulanda, traha y hosa den UE. Nos ta busca tres sosio fundador pa forma esaki prome cu e sali. Sosionan piloto ta forma parti di e conseho di gobernacion y ta fiha e reglanan di acreditacion.

Un carta di intencion di un pagina ta tur loke nos mester. Sin obligacion, sin compromiso financiero, sin exclusividad.
pilot.name: Nomber
pilot.done: Recibi. Nos ta contesta den dos dia — di un persona humano.
pilot.follow: No ta un organizacion pero kier sigui e desaroyo? Laga bo e-mail pa recibi noticia tur luna.
close.line1: Nos ta duna poder na e red.
footer.text:
Redaura — un fundacion sin fin di lucro registra na Hulanda.
Diseña, traha y hosa den UE.

__source.meta.title: Redaura — alert infrastructure for harm reduction
__source.hero.sub: Redaura lets drug-checking and harm-reduction organizations send a warning to every phone in a defined area, in seconds, in the reader's own language, credited to their organization by name.
__source.hero.pushBody: Near you: pills sold as MDMA contain PMMA. Alert by Unity · Jellinek.
__source.stats.l1: From approval to phones in the area
__source.gap.p1: A drug-checking team finds a mislabelled sample at a festival at 1am. They have the result, the equipment, and twenty years of trust with the people at that festival. Their only way to spread the warning is a whiteboard outside the tent and a post that reaches whoever is already following them.
__source.gap.p2: National monitoring systems have the reach, but not this mandate. They aggregate, they track trends, they issue guidance over weeks. They were never built to put a warning on thirty thousand phones tonight.
__source.gap.heading: Redaura connects the two.
__source.feat1.title: Only vetted organizations publish
__source.feat1.copy: Accreditation happens before an account exists. A volunteer at the testing point drafts the alert; a designated lead releases it. Two people, every time.
__source.feat2.title: Structured alerts, not free text
__source.feat2.copy: Alerts are built from fixed fields, not written as prose. Every value is expert-reviewed in 20+ languages, so a Dutch team's warning arrives natively in Polish or German with no translation step and no room for slang or ambiguity.
__source.feat3.title: Nobody is tracked
__source.feat3.copy: Matching happens on the device — the phone works out whether it's inside an alert area. Nothing is transmitted, nothing is logged, nothing can be subpoenaed. That's the architecture, not a setting.
__source.feat4.title: The data goes both ways
__source.feat4.copy: Because alerts are structured, the same publication that reaches phones tonight can reach national monitoring tonight, in a format their systems already read.
__source.feat.offline.title: Built for dead zones.
__source.feat.offline.body: Festival cell networks saturate exactly when alerts matter most. The app opens instantly with last-known alerts, shows when it last synced, and catches up on the thinnest sliver of signal. Alerts arrive inside the push itself — readable even when nothing else loads.
__source.app.title: One app.
__source.app.note1: Users download a single global client; the alerts on it belong to the organizations that publish them — their name, their logo, their lab reference. The trust built on the ground travels with the warning.
__source.app.note2: Tap an alert to open it. A push lands a few seconds later, or replay it under the phone.
__source.quote.text: “We have the volunteers, the test kits, and twenty years of trust. What we never had was €50,000 for an app.”
__source.quote.attr: — Drug checking coordinator, prospective pilot partner
__source.proto.lead: Alerts are published in an open, documented format — any org, lab, or national early-warning system can publish and consume them. Zero lock-in, fully mappable to the CAP emergency-alert standard.
__source.proto.point1.title: Yours forever
__source.proto.point1.body: Export all alert data, schemas, and history at any time. No proprietary formats or locked databases.
__source.proto.point2.title: Interoperable
__source.proto.point2.body: Connects directly to existing early-warning systems and public safety infrastructure.
__source.proto.point3.title: Mission-proof
__source.proto.point3.body: The open specification outlives any single company or organization. Harm reduction infrastructure stays public.
__source.proto.bridge: Founding partners help shape the specification from day one →
__source.pilot.title: Working prototype. Open protocol.
__source.pilot.note:
A non-profit registered in the Netherlands, built and hosted in the EU. We're looking for three founding partners — drug-checking services, peer-support networks, or regional health bodies — to shape this before it ships. Pilot partners sit on the governance board and set the accreditation rules.

A one-page letter of intent is all we need. Non-binding, no funding commitment, no exclusivity.
__source.pilot.name: Name
__source.pilot.done: Received. We'll reply within two days — from a human.
__source.pilot.follow: Not an organization but want to follow along? Leave an email — updates roughly monthly.
__source.footer.text:
Redaura — a non-profit organisation registered in the Netherlands.
Designed, built, and hosted in the EU.
